**Update: the map stays on your main window**

## Fixed

- **The map hack no longer jumps to a BoBarb or Filler window** when you switch windows. It only moves to another window you play on, and Start never puts it on a BoBarb or Filler window either.
- **Fast alt-tabbing no longer restarts the map over and over** (this could crash the app). The map only moves once a new window has stayed in front for about a second and a half, instead of restarting on every switch.

Tickets and feedback are always welcome. Use **REQUEST FEATURE** in the top bar.
